messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: Error in modeling- Help me
parts:
This is an ENMeval message telling you that at least one predictor variable raster is missing 2811 cells with a value that the other rasters have. Perhaps you are using one or more predictor variables from a different source dataset? If your rasters are high resolution, then 2811 cells is not too many, but if they are low resolution, this can be a considerable portion of your extent. I suggest you examine the rasters using QGIS or ArcGIS to see where the mismatch is. If it's not a big problem, just ignore this warning. ENMeval will convert all these cells to NA across all your rasters.

Jamie
